stem:
Meera records the maximum and minimum air temperatures at her home in Jaipur every day for one week in March, using a maximum-minimum thermometer. Her brother says, "The maximum and minimum temperatures must be exactly the same on every day of the week."
Which statement about her records is correct?

options.text: The maximum and minimum temperatures are always the same every day, because the same thermometer is used.
The maximum and minimum temperatures usually vary from day to day, because weather conditions change.
The maximum temperature must rise and the minimum temperature must fall every single day.
The maximum and minimum temperatures never change during the year, whatever the season.

teacher.key_rationale: Maximum and minimum air temperatures vary day to day because weather depends on several factors, and they generally rise as summer approaches. Option B states this correctly. Option A wrongly ties constancy to using one thermometer (condition/drop trap), C overstates a daily fixed pattern, and D denies seasonal variation entirely.
